research.headline: RTY SHORT · Double Top on 1H · ELITE 9/10
research.thesis: Screen 1 has no directional bias, so this is traded on the formation alone rather than as a trend continuation (Ch IX). A Double Top completed on the 1H over 20 bars (the same ceiling rejected twice, the second attempt failing where the first did), grading textbook on 3 of 3 preferred filters (Ch XI pattern quality 2/2). The 15M closed at 2,318.66, 0.24 ATR through the confirmation line at 2,319.10 on 2.41x the 20-bar average volume, then price returned to the level and was rejected by a strong wick. The fill was taken on that rejection, which is the Method B fill the firm defaults to. The measured move projects 2,273.25, worth 32.27R against the stop at 2,319.82; the firm's floor is 2:1 (Ch VIII-A).
